Container.Name: Cody
Container.Overview: Cody — a self-hosted web workspace for coding agents. Session browsing, live chat, Git panel with staging and checkpoints, persistent terminals, workspace tasks, and an embedded app preview. Bring your own engine: omp (oh-my-pi), Claude Code or Codex install from the onboarding picker and update independently of this image. Includes everyday dev tools (git, gh, python3, ripgrep, jq) and optional SSH access that drops you straight into the active engine's CLI. Point /workspace at your projects share, open the WebUI and create your admin account.

Config.Name: SSH Port
Config.Description: SSH into the container (only active once SSH Password is set, or keys exist in appdata/home/.ssh/authorized_keys). Logging in lands in the active coding engine's CLI; exiting it drops to a shell.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Agent state, checkpoints and shell home. Keep on appdata.

Config.Name: Projects
Config.Description: Your repositories — the workspaces Cody and the agent operate on.

Config.Name: Password (optional)
Config.Description: Leave empty: on first open the WebUI walks you through creating your admin account. Setting a password additionally enables the built-in 'cody' account for HTTP Basic Auth (scripts, health probes).

Config.Name: Allow Account Signup
Config.Description: Leave empty (or 1) to allow creating new accounts from the login screen. Set to 0 to restrict account creation to administrators in Settings > User Accounts.

Config.Name: SSH Password
Config.Description: Optional: root password for SSH access. Leave empty to keep SSH off (or use key-only auth by adding public keys to appdata/home/.ssh/authorized_keys).

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Optional: API key for the agent's model provider. Any provider env var omp understands can be added the same way.
